decidedBy: Essenthos, 2026-10-15, on the project owner's ruling of 2026-10-15 on 1 Chronicles 8:29 ('давай тоді як мінімум тут додати ще картку народа… додай народ як мінімум', add at least the people) and his instruction to treat the same construction alike; each word read against its verse and the Hebrew by claude-opus-5-5
policy: Chronicles' 'father of <town>' (אֲבִי + the town) names the town and, through it, its people: where a people record for that town is held, the town's word carries the people beside the place in every text the links reach.
source: Essenthos, 'father of' a town read as the town's people beside it, on the project owner's ruling of 2026-10-15

rulings.why: Ashur 'the father of Tekoa' (אֲבִי תְקוֹעַ, avi teqoa): the town Tekoa, whose people are the Tekoites (2SA 23:26, NEH 3:5).
Mesha 'the father of Ziph' (אֲבִי זִיף, avi ziph): the town Ziph, whose people are the Ziphites (1SA 23:19).
Salma 'the father of Bethlehem' (אֲבִי בֵית־לָחֶם, avi beit-lachem): the town Bethlehem, whose people are the Bethlehemites (1SA 16:1).
Hur 'the father of Bethlehem' (אֲבִי בֵית לָחֶם, avi beit lachem): the town Bethlehem, whose people are the Bethlehemites.
Ashur 'the father of Tekoa' (אֲבִי תְקוֹעַ, avi teqoa), as in 1CH 2:24: the town Tekoa, whose people are the Tekoites.
'The father of Gibeon' (אֲבִי גִבְעוֹן, avi giv'on) dwelt at Gibeon: the town and its people, the Gibeonites; the Synodal prints it as the people, «отец Гаваонитян».
Jeiel 'the father of Gibeon' (אֲבִי גִבְעוֹן, avi giv'on) dwelt at Gibeon: the town and its people, the Gibeonites; the Synodal prints it as the people, «отец Гаваонитян».
